new_result.statement: For Q=2(X0+ell.X_L)(g.X_L)+d(beta.X_L)^2, if a literal source split L=J union K has g_K=0, rho=||beta_K||>0 and ell_K=a beta_K, with no restriction on ell_J, then Q has a density with ||p_Q||inf <= 2^(13/4)/(rho sqrt(|d| ||g||)).
new_result.regularity: essential boundedness only; continuity not proved
new_result.mechanism: LPP k=1 on G and private B projections; conditional half-Riesz budget from the genuine hub X0; random-centre square converts half-Riesz to L-infinity

literature.LPP: Livshyts--Paouris--Pivovarov, arXiv:1507.07949 / Israel J. Math. 216 (2016): product marginal cap 2^(k/2); used exactly at k=1.
literature.Banks_scope_correction: Banks--Garza Vargas--Kulkarni--Srivastava arXiv:2005.08930 Cor. 2.4 already covers k=1,j>=2 pure two-bank bilinear/affine rank-two subcase. Do not claim novelty for that narrow subcase; it does not subsume arbitrary H(U) or the random-centre square receiver.
